en.t: Some patients go to my parents' home for treatment.
Well, I do not mind either way.

units.source_text: 我父亲边吃晚饭边开心地笑。

en.t: My father laughed cheerfully as he ate dinner.

units.source_text: 他说今天有个生过孩子的孕妇来，却装着是初次怀孕。”

en.t: He said that today a pregnant woman who had already given birth came in, but pretended it was her first pregnancy.

units.source_text: （再没有比鉴定处女的征候和初生婴儿的死因更困难的了。）

en.t: There is nothing more difficult than determining the signs of virginity or the cause of death of a newborn baby.
